desc: Establish the BFS-layer characterization: edges are only within/consecutive layers and each non-root-layer vertex has a predecessor neighbor; exact layerings are unique.
Derive the exact BFS-layer transfer recurrence, including internal-layer edges and nonempty predecessor-edge subsets.
Correct incremental labeled-vertex counting: parity groups must be selected from all non-root labels, not fixed preassigned pools.
Validate the corrected implementation against all stated samples and boundary cases.
